cases.explain: «Иудейская земля» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of Yahweh of Armies, which he determines against it.

cases.sentence: В тот день пять ___ будут говорить на языке Ханаана и клясться в верности Господу Сил.
cases.explain: «египетских городов» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Yahweh of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”

cases.sentence: В тот день жертвенник Господу будет посередине Египта, и ___ Господу — на его границе.
cases.explain: «памятный знак» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: In that day, there will be an altar to Yahweh in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to Yahweh at its border.

cases.sentence: В тот день будет ___ из Египта в Ассирию.
cases.explain: «широкая дорога» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.
